description: This file defines the EntityCache class, which manages caching of entity data using primary keys and entity conditions within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityCache
classes.description: A cache management class for entity data, providing methods to get, put, and remove entity values based on primary keys and conditions within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: EntityCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with a delegator name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue from the cache based on its primary key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a GenericValue to the cache, using its primary key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a GenericValue to the cache with a specified primary key, respecting the entity's never-cache setting.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes entities matching a condition from the cache for a specific entity name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific GenericValue from the cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry based on its primary key and clears related view convertors caches.
